courses.title: 極紫外金屬氧化物光阻研究
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究吸收與反應路徑、塗膜與表面、曝光與統計、轉移與驗證；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: absorption and reaction, coating and surfaces, exposure and statistics, transfer and validation. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
courses.scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

stages.title: 吸收與反應路徑
stages.description: 金屬氧化物光阻的吸收、配體反應與不溶化必須分開驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Absorption, ligand reactions and insolubilization require separate evidence in metal-oxide resists.

steps.title: 畫出光子到溶解度的因果鏈
steps.titleEn: Trace photons to changed solubility
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：吸收與化學轉換不是同一事件。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Absorption and chemical conversion are different events.
steps.instruction: 畫出光子到溶解度的因果鏈。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。附上帶材料、方向與尺度標記的示意圖，圈出一處不能由圖單獨推論的量。最後以「吸收與化學轉換不是同一事件。」檢查推論是否超出證據。
steps.instructionEn: Trace photons to changed solubility. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Attach a diagram labeled with materials, directions and scales; circle one quantity not inferable from the drawing alone. Finally check your inference against this principle: Absorption and chemical conversion are different events.
steps.observation: 吸收與化學轉換不是同一事件。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
steps.observationEn: Absorption and chemical conversion are different events. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
steps.failure: 若報告假設「吸收更多就必定具有較低缺陷。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
steps.failureEn: If the report assumes "Greater absorption necessarily guarantees fewer defects.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
steps.check: 交付「畫出光子到溶解度的因果鏈」的圖表或計算、採用來源、假設與單位；說明本步結論「吸收與化學轉換不是同一事件。」可由哪些證據支持，並保留一項限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the diagram, table or calculation for "Trace photons to changed solubility", with sources, assumptions and units. Identify evidence supporting "Absorption and chemical conversion are different events." and retain one limitation.

knowledge.textEn: Absorption and chemical conversion are different events.

knowledge.title: 吸收與反應路徑的原理與限制
knowledge.titleEn: Absorption and reaction: principle and limits
knowledge.text: 金屬氧化物光阻的吸收、配體反應與不溶化必須分開驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Absorption, ligand reactions and insolubilization require separate evidence in metal-oxide resists.

quiz.question: 完成「畫出光子到溶解度的因果鏈」後，哪項判讀可靠？
quiz.questionEn: After "Trace photons to changed solubility", which interpretation is defensible?
options: 吸收與化學轉換不是同一事件。
吸收更多就必定具有較低缺陷。
相同厚度就表示化學組成相同。
optionsEn: Absorption and chemical conversion are different events.
Greater absorption necessarily guarantees fewer defects.
Equal thickness proves equal chemical composition.
quiz.explanation: 吸收與化學轉換不是同一事件。 金屬氧化物光阻的吸收、配體反應與不溶化必須分開驗證。
quiz.explanationEn: Absorption and chemical conversion are different events. Absorption, ligand reactions and insolubilization require separate evidence in metal-oxide resists.

steps.title: 以假設吸收係數計算厚度衰減
steps.titleEn: Calculate attenuation using an assumed absorption coefficient
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：Beer–Lambert 模型須標明均勻薄膜假設。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Beer–Lambert modeling assumes a uniform film.
steps.instruction:
以假設吸收係數計算厚度衰減。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。建立因果與量測對照表，區分直接觀測、模型推論與尚需額外證據的結論。最後以「Beer–Lambert 模型須標明均勻薄膜假設。」檢查推論是否超出證據。

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：假設均勻膜的吸收係數 α=0.020 nm⁻¹、厚度 t=20 nm、入射光子數 100。計算 T=exp(-αt)=0.6703，約 67.0 個等效光子穿透、33.0 個被吸收；厚度改為 40 nm 時吸收比例為 55.1%。比較吸收增加與實際化學轉換兩件事，不能由此計算單獨宣告感度或缺陷率。
steps.instructionEn:
Calculate attenuation using an assumed absorption coefficient. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Build a cause–measurement table separating direct observations, model inferences and conclusions needing more evidence. Finally check your inference against this principle: Beer–Lambert modeling assumes a uniform film.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Assume a uniform-film absorption coefficient α=0.020 nm⁻¹, thickness t=20 nm and 100 incident equivalent photons. T=exp(-αt)=0.6703 gives 67.0 transmitted and 33.0 absorbed. At 40 nm, absorption becomes 55.1%. Separate increased absorption from chemical conversion; this calculation alone establishes neither sensitivity nor defect rate.
steps.observation:
Beer–Lambert 模型須標明均勻薄膜假設。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
結果須有 33.0% 與 55.1%，並註明反應產率尚未量測。
steps.observationEn:
Beer–Lambert modeling assumes a uniform film. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Report 33.0% and 55.1%, explicitly noting that reaction yield is unmeasured.
steps.failure: 若報告假設「吸收更多就必定具有較低缺陷。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
steps.failureEn: If the report assumes "Greater absorption necessarily guarantees fewer defects.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
steps.check:
交付「以假設吸收係數計算厚度衰減」的圖表或計算、採用來源、假設與單位；說明本步結論「Beer–Lambert 模型須標明均勻薄膜假設。」可由哪些證據支持，並保留一項限制。
本例驗收：結果須有 33.0% 與 55.1%，並註明反應產率尚未量測。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the diagram, table or calculation for "Calculate attenuation using an assumed absorption coefficient", with sources, assumptions and units. Identify evidence supporting "Beer–Lambert modeling assumes a uniform film." and retain one limitation.
Example acceptance: Report 33.0% and 55.1%, explicitly noting that reaction yield is unmeasured.

courses.summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: data and scale, beam and placement, dose and stitching, mask acceptance. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。

Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

steps.title: 分別估算束流與駐留時間的劑量
steps.titleEn: Estimate dose from beam current and dwell time
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：劑量是電荷除以曝光面積。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Dose is charge divided by exposed area.
steps.instruction:
分別估算束流與駐留時間的劑量。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。附上帶材料、方向與尺度標記的示意圖，圈出一處不能由圖單獨推論的量。最後以「劑量是電荷除以曝光面積。」檢查推論是否超出證據。

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：假設某圖元曝光面積為 100 μm²、所需總電荷為 0.20 nC、束流為 1.0 nA。先換算 100 μm²=10⁻⁶ cm²，再得面劑量 200 μC/cm²，理想駐留總時間 Q/I=0.20 s。另有 0.10 s 載台與資料開銷時，總時間是 0.30 s；不可把理想束流時間當作整體吞吐量。
steps.instructionEn:
Estimate dose from beam current and dwell time. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Attach a diagram labeled with materials, directions and scales; circle one quantity not inferable from the drawing alone. Finally check your inference against this principle: Dose is charge divided by exposed area.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Assume a 100 μm² exposed area, total charge 0.20 nC and beam current 1.0 nA. Convert the area to 10⁻⁶ cm²: dose is 200 μC/cm² and ideal beam time Q/I is 0.20 s. With 0.10 s of stage and data overhead, total time is 0.30 s; beam time alone is not throughput.
steps.observation:
劑量是電荷除以曝光面積。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
確認面積換算、200 μC/cm² 與 0.30 s，分開曝光和開銷。
steps.observationEn:
Dose is charge divided by exposed area. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：假設盲測標準片有 100 處已知缺陷及 100 處已知正常區。檢查器找出 90 處真缺陷，但將 5 處正常區誤報。列出 TP=90、FN=10、FP=5、TN=95；漏檢率為 10%，誤報率為 5%。若只報告 95 次警報，無法得知靈敏度；並須說明此結果只適用於標準片所涵蓋的缺陷尺寸與類型。
steps.instructionEn:
Calculate miss and false-alarm rates. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Use explicitly hypothetical data for one calculation or classification; retain units, denominators and intermediate results. Finally check your inference against this principle: Higher sensitivity can increase review burden.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): A hypothetical blind standard contains 100 known defects and 100 clean sites. Inspection detects 90 true defects and falsely flags 5 clean sites: TP=90, FN=10, FP=5, TN=95. The miss rate is 10% and false-positive rate 5%. Reporting 95 alarms alone cannot establish sensitivity. The result applies only to the defect sizes and classes represented by the standard.

courses.summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: amplitude and phase, mask structures, imaging window, metrology and integration. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.

steps.title: 計算零與半週期相位差的合成強度
steps.titleEn: Calculate intensity at zero and half-cycle phase difference
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：理想反相等振幅場可相消。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Ideal equal-amplitude opposing fields can cancel.
steps.instruction:
計算零與半週期相位差的合成強度。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。建立兩種條件的對照表，分別寫出固定量、改變量與可量測的輸出。最後以「理想反相等振幅場可相消。」檢查推論是否超出證據。

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：假設兩束相干光的振幅皆為 1。相位差 0 時，I=|1+1|²=4；相位差 π 時，I=|1-1|²=0。若第二束振幅僅 0.8，反相後 I=|1-0.8|²=0.04，便不是完全黑暗。畫出複數向量，說明相位正確仍需要振幅匹配；此為兩束光模型，不是完整投影系統。
steps.instructionEn:
Calculate intensity at zero and half-cycle phase difference. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Build a two-condition comparison table listing fixed quantities, changed quantities and measurable outputs. Finally check your inference against this principle: Ideal equal-amplitude opposing fields can cancel.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Assume coherent fields with amplitudes 1 and 1. At phase difference 0, I=|1+1|²=4; at π, I=|1-1|²=0. If the second amplitude is 0.8, opposing fields give I=|1-0.8|²=0.04 rather than complete darkness. Draw complex vectors and explain why phase alone is insufficient without amplitude matching. This is a two-field model, not a complete projection system.

knowledge.text: 光學相位、透射率與幾何位置須分別量測。
knowledge.textEn: Optical phase, transmission and geometric placement require separate measurements.

quiz.question: 完成「比較光罩端與晶圓端驗收」後，哪項判讀可靠？
quiz.questionEn: After "Compare mask-side and wafer-side acceptance", which interpretation is defensible?
options: 幾何厚度相同就必定相位相同。
光罩量測必須能連結晶圓成像需求。
只需把兩束光強相加。
optionsEn: Equal geometric thickness necessarily means equal phase.
Mask metrology must link to wafer imaging requirements.
Simply add the two intensities.
quiz.explanation: 光罩量測必須能連結晶圓成像需求。 光學相位、透射率與幾何位置須分別量測。
quiz.explanationEn: Mask metrology must link to wafer imaging requirements. Optical phase, transmission and geometric placement require separate measurements.

steps.title: 提交相位配置與成像窗口設計審查
steps.titleEn: Review phase assignment and imaging window together
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：設計可印性與光罩可製造性需共同成立。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Printability and mask manufacturability must both hold.
steps.instruction: 提交相位配置與成像窗口設計審查。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。完成一頁審查紀錄，列出接受條件、證據缺口與不應外推的範圍。最後以「設計可印性與光罩可製造性需共同成立。」檢查推論是否超出證據。
steps.instructionEn: Review phase assignment and imaging window together. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Complete a one-page review listing acceptance criteria, evidence gaps and limits on extrapolation. Finally check your inference against this principle: Printability and mask manufacturability must both hold.
steps.observation: 設計可印性與光罩可製造性需共同成立。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
steps.observationEn: Printability and mask manufacturability must both hold. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
steps.failure: 若報告假設「幾何厚度相同就必定相位相同。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
steps.failureEn: If the report assumes "Equal geometric thickness necessarily means equal phase.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
steps.check: 交付「提交相位配置與成像窗口設計審查」的圖表或計算、採用來源、假設與單位；說明本步結論「設計可印性與光罩可製造性需共同成立。」可由哪些證據支持，並保留一項限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the diagram, table or calculation for "Review phase assignment and imaging window together", with sources, assumptions and units. Identify evidence supporting "Printability and mask manufacturability must both hold." and retain one limitation.

courses.title: 光學鄰近修正
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究成像誤差、模型校準、局部修正、窗口驗證；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: imaging error, model calibration, local correction, window validation. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
courses.scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

stages.title: 成像誤差
stages.description: OPC 修正光罩以補償成像及製程偏差，不是任意更改電路目標。
stages.descriptionEn: OPC modifies masks to compensate imaging and process bias, not to arbitrarily alter circuit targets.

steps.title: 疊合設計輪廓與模擬晶圓輪廓
steps.titleEn: Overlay target and simulated wafer contours
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：邊緣位置誤差需以共同座標計算。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Edge-placement error requires common coordinates.
steps.instruction: 疊合設計輪廓與模擬晶圓輪廓。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。附上帶材料、方向與尺度標記的示意圖，圈出一處不能由圖單獨推論的量。最後以「邊緣位置誤差需以共同座標計算。」檢查推論是否超出證據。
steps.instructionEn: Overlay target and simulated wafer contours. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Attach a diagram labeled with materials, directions and scales; circle one quantity not inferable from the drawing alone. Finally check your inference against this principle: Edge-placement error requires common coordinates.
steps.observation: 邊緣位置誤差需以共同座標計算。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
steps.observationEn: Edge-placement error requires common coordinates. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
steps.failure: 若報告假設「直接把最終晶圓圖形複製到光罩即可。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
steps.failureEn: If the report assumes "Directly copy target wafer geometry onto the mask.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
steps.check: 交付「疊合設計輪廓與模擬晶圓輪廓」的圖表或計算、採用來源、假設與單位；說明本步結論「邊緣位置誤差需以共同座標計算。」可由哪些證據支持，並保留一項限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the diagram, table or calculation for "Overlay target and simulated wafer contours", with sources, assumptions and units. Identify evidence supporting "Edge-placement error requires common coordinates." and retain one limitation.

steps.title: 逐次更新邊緣並觀察誤差收斂
steps.titleEn: Update edges iteratively and track error convergence
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：過大更新可能振盪。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Oversized updates can cause oscillation.
steps.instruction:
逐次更新邊緣並觀察誤差收斂。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。建立因果與量測對照表，區分直接觀測、模型推論與尚需額外證據的結論。最後以「過大更新可能振盪。」檢查推論是否超出證據。

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：設目標晶圓邊緣 x=100 nm，初始模擬位置 x=94 nm。採用局部線性教學模型：4 倍縮小光罩的邊緣移動 +8 nm，晶圓邊緣只移動 +2 nm。一次修正後位置為 96 nm，帶符號誤差由 -6 nm 變為 -4 nm。不要把光罩 +8 nm 直接加到晶圓；實際 OPC 須重新模擬鄰近耦合，不能永遠沿用此固定斜率。
steps.instructionEn:
Update edges iteratively and track error convergence. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Build a cause–measurement table separating direct observations, model inferences and conclusions needing more evidence. Finally check your inference against this principle: Oversized updates can cause oscillation.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Let the wafer target edge be x=100 nm and the initial prediction x=94 nm. In a local linear teaching model with 4× mask reduction, moving a mask edge +8 nm shifts the wafer edge only +2 nm. The new prediction is 96 nm and signed error changes from -6 to -4 nm. Do not add mask displacement directly to the wafer. Real OPC needs neighborhood resimulation instead of assuming this slope always holds.
steps.observation:
過大更新可能振盪。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
交付修正前後 -6 nm 與 -4 nm，以及光罩／晶圓尺度標記。
steps.observationEn:
Oversized updates can cause oscillation. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Report -6 nm and -4 nm with explicit mask/wafer scale labels.

steps.failureEn: If the report assumes "Every edge can be corrected independently.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
steps.check:
交付「逐次更新邊緣並觀察誤差收斂」的圖表或計算、採用來源、假設與單位；說明本步結論「過大更新可能振盪。」可由哪些證據支持，並保留一項限制。
本例驗收：交付修正前後 -6 nm 與 -4 nm，以及光罩／晶圓尺度標記。

Example acceptance: Report -6 nm and -4 nm with explicit mask/wafer scale labels.

courses.title: 反向微影計算
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究反問題定義、最佳化設計、可製造性、穩健驗證；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: inverse problem, optimization design, manufacturability, robust validation. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
courses.scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

stages.description: 反向微影從目標晶圓輪廓求光罩，通常存在多種候選解。
stages.descriptionEn: Inverse lithography solves for masks from target wafer contours and can admit multiple solutions.

courses.title: 極紫外曝光製程整合
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究系統與圖形、材料與光罩、窗口與缺陷、電性與整合；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: system and patterns, materials and masks, window and defects, electrical integration. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
courses.scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

stages.title: 系統與圖形
stages.description: EUV 以反射式光學與真空路徑成像，材料與光罩都參與成像誤差。
stages.descriptionEn: EUV uses reflective optics and vacuum paths; materials and masks both contribute imaging errors.

steps.title: 畫出光源至晶圓的反射路徑
steps.titleEn: Sketch the reflective source-to-wafer path
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：EUV 光路各反射介面都影響能量。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Each reflecting interface affects EUV throughput.
steps.instruction:
畫出光源至晶圓的反射路徑。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。附上帶材料、方向與尺度標記的示意圖，圈出一處不能由圖單獨推論的量。最後以「EUV 光路各反射介面都影響能量。」檢查推論是否超出證據。

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：在假設的四面反射鏡教學光路中，每面能量反射率皆為 0.70，且忽略其他損失。總傳輸比例為 0.70⁴=0.2401；100 單位入射能量只剩 24.01 單位。若其中一面因污染變成 0.60，剩餘為 0.70³×0.60=20.58，較原來降低 14.3%。本例鏡數與反射率不是任何 EUV 機台規格。
steps.instructionEn:
Sketch the reflective source-to-wafer path. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Attach a diagram labeled with materials, directions and scales; circle one quantity not inferable from the drawing alone. Finally check your inference against this principle: Each reflecting interface affects EUV throughput.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): In a hypothetical four-mirror path, each mirror has energy reflectivity 0.70 and other losses are ignored. Total transmission is 0.70⁴=0.2401, leaving 24.01 of 100 incident energy units. If one mirror falls to 0.60, the result is 0.70³×0.60=20.58, a 14.3% relative decrease. Mirror count and reflectivities are not specifications of any EUV scanner.
steps.observation:
EUV 光路各反射介面都影響能量。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
用乘積得到 24.01 與 20.58，不可把反射率直接相加。
steps.observationEn:
Each reflecting interface affects EUV throughput. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Use products to obtain 24.01 and 20.58; do not add reflectivities.
steps.failure: 若報告假設「EUV 可直接套用透射玻璃鏡頭。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
steps.failureEn: If the report assumes "EUV can directly use transmitting glass lenses.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
steps.check:
交付「畫出光源至晶圓的反射路徑」的圖表或計算、採用來源、假設與單位；說明本步結論「EUV 光路各反射介面都影響能量。」可由哪些證據支持，並保留一項限制。
本例驗收：用乘積得到 24.01 與 20.58，不可把反射率直接相加。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the diagram, table or calculation for "Sketch the reflective source-to-wafer path", with sources, assumptions and units. Identify evidence supporting "Each reflecting interface affects EUV throughput." and retain one limitation.
Example acceptance: Use products to obtain 24.01 and 20.58; do not add reflectivities.

courses.title: 雙重圖案化製程
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究分解與配色、曝光與轉移、誤差分配、整合比較；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: decomposition and coloring, exposure and transfer, error allocation, integration comparison. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
courses.scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

steps.instruction:

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：設兩組交錯線條在完美對位時的左右間隙皆為 40 nm。第二組向右偏移 5 nm，而線寬不變，則左右間隙變成 45 nm 與 35 nm，平均仍為 40 nm。若最小間隙要求為 36 nm，這組圖形不合格，即使平均間隙完全正確。畫出帶方向的套刻向量與兩個間隙。
steps.instructionEn:
Sketch alternating spaces caused by overlay shift. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Attach a diagram labeled with materials, directions and scales; circle one quantity not inferable from the drawing alone. Finally check your inference against this principle: Relative displacement produces alternating spacing.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Two interleaved line sets have 40 nm gaps on both sides at ideal alignment. Shift the second set 5 nm right without changing widths: gaps become 45 and 35 nm while their mean remains 40 nm. A 36 nm minimum-gap requirement is violated despite the correct mean. Draw the signed overlay vector and both gaps.

Relative displacement produces alternating spacing. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Report 45/35 nm and the failure reason, identifying the mean-value blind spot.

courses.title: 自我對準四重圖案化
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究骨架與倍增、第一輪側壁、第二輪與切割、誤差與電性；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: mandrels and multiplication, first spacer cycle, second cycle and cuts, errors and electrical tests. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
courses.scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

steps.title: 畫出最初骨架與最終四倍線群
steps.titleEn: Draw initial mandrels and final fourfold line sets
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：骨架週期與最終節距不同。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Mandrel period differs from final pitch.
steps.instruction:
畫出最初骨架與最終四倍線群。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。附上帶材料、方向與尺度標記的示意圖，圈出一處不能由圖單獨推論的量。最後以「骨架週期與最終節距不同。」檢查推論是否超出證據。

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：設理想骨架節距為 160 nm；每輪側壁倍增恰好使規則線群節距減半。第一輪為 80 nm，第二輪為 40 nm。這並不表示最終線寬是 40 nm：若目標線寬為 15 nm，名目間隙應為 25 nm。另標記切割光罩的位置需求，避免把四倍線密度誤解為完整電路已完成。
steps.instructionEn:
Draw initial mandrels and final fourfold line sets. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Attach a diagram labeled with materials, directions and scales; circle one quantity not inferable from the drawing alone. Finally check your inference against this principle: Mandrel period differs from final pitch.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Assume an ideal 160 nm mandrel pitch and each spacer multiplication exactly halves regular-line pitch. The first cycle gives 80 nm and the second 40 nm. Final linewidth is not therefore 40 nm: a 15 nm line leaves a nominal 25 nm gap. Also mark cut-mask placement requirements so fourfold line density is not mistaken for a completed circuit.
steps.observation:
骨架週期與最終節距不同。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
須區分 160→80→40 nm 節距、15 nm 線寬及 25 nm 間隙。
steps.observationEn:
Mandrel period differs from final pitch. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Distinguish 160→80→40 nm pitch, 15 nm width and 25 nm gap.
steps.failure: 若報告假設「SAQP 就是連續曝光四次。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
steps.failureEn: If the report assumes "SAQP means exposing four times.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
steps.check:

本例驗收：須區分 160→80→40 nm 節距、15 nm 線寬及 25 nm 間隙。
steps.checkEn:

Example acceptance: Distinguish 160→80→40 nm pitch, 15 nm width and 25 nm gap.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Inspect 10⁶ hypothetical independent, identically distributed assembly sites and observe no defects. Sketch dispersed and clustered sampling and explain the independence requirement.

knowledge.text: 假設對 10⁶ 個獨立且同分布的自組裝位置檢查，未發現缺陷。以零事件近似 95% 上限 3/N，得到 p<約 3×10⁻⁶；不是 p=0。若空間群聚讓有效獨立樣本數只剩 10⁵，上限變為約 3×10⁻⁵。畫出分散與群聚取樣，說明需先驗證獨立性。
knowledge.textEn: Inspect 10⁶ hypothetical independent, identically distributed assembly sites and observe no defects. The approximate zero-event 95% upper bound 3/N is about 3×10⁻⁶, not zero. If spatial clustering reduces effective independent samples to 10⁵, the bound becomes about 3×10⁻⁵. Sketch dispersed and clustered sampling and explain the independence requirement.

quiz.question: 完成「估算檢查面積與罕見缺陷信賴區間」後，哪項判讀可靠？
quiz.questionEn: After "Relate inspected area to rare-defect confidence", which interpretation is defensible?
options: 單張顯微照片足以證明零缺陷。
樣本面積限制可聲稱的缺陷率。
聚合物圖案可直接等同最終金屬線。
optionsEn: One micrograph proves zero defects.
Sample area limits supportable defect-rate claims.
Polymer patterns are equivalent to final metal lines.
quiz.explanation: 樣本面積限制可聲稱的缺陷率。 漂亮的局部排列不能替代大面積缺陷統計。
quiz.explanationEn: Sample area limits supportable defect-rate claims. Attractive local ordering does not replace large-area defect statistics.

workedExample.textEn: Inspect 10⁶ hypothetical independent, identically distributed assembly sites and observe no defects. The approximate zero-event 95% upper bound 3/N is about 3×10⁻⁶, not zero. If spatial clustering reduces effective independent samples to 10⁵, the bound becomes about 3×10⁻⁵. Sketch dispersed and clustered sampling and explain the independence requirement.

courses.title: 奈米壓印微影
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究模板與樹脂、填充與對位、固化與脫模、缺陷與轉移；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: template and resin, filling and alignment, curing and release, defects and transfer. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
courses.scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

steps.title: 依局部圖案體積規畫滴液分布
steps.titleEn: Plan droplets using local pattern volume
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：均勻滴液未必得到均勻殘留層。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Uniform droplets need not yield uniform residual layers.
steps.instruction:
依局部圖案體積規畫滴液分布。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。附上帶材料、方向與尺度標記的示意圖，圈出一處不能由圖單獨推論的量。最後以「均勻滴液未必得到均勻殘留層。」檢查推論是否超出證據。

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：假設模板凹槽總體積 100 μm³，壓印區面積 1000 μm²，目標殘留層厚度 0.020 μm。理想所需樹脂體積為 100+1000×0.020=120 μm³。若滴入 140 μm³且完全填充、沒有流出或收縮，殘留層為 (140-100)/1000=0.040 μm，即 40 nm。實際還需評估氣泡、收縮與局部密度，不能只用總體積保證均勻。
steps.instructionEn:
Plan droplets using local pattern volume. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Attach a diagram labeled with materials, directions and scales; circle one quantity not inferable from the drawing alone. Finally check your inference against this principle: Uniform droplets need not yield uniform residual layers.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Assume 100 μm³ of template-cavity volume, 1000 μm² imprint area and a target 0.020 μm residual layer. Ideal resin volume is 100+1000×0.020=120 μm³. Dispensing 140 μm³ with complete filling and no outflow or shrinkage yields (140-100)/1000=0.040 μm, or 40 nm, residual thickness. Bubbles, shrinkage and local density still matter; total volume does not guarantee uniformity.

courses.title: 電子束直接寫入
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究資料與束斑、曝光與散射、對位與拼接、顯影與驗證；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: data and spot, exposure and scattering, alignment and stitching, development and validation. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
courses.scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

courses.title: 套刻誤差量測與補償
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究向量與標記、誤差模型、量測品質、補償與驗證；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: vectors and marks, error models, measurement quality, correction and validation. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
courses.scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：在簡化一維例中，x=-1 mm 的套刻位移為 +1 nm，x=+1 mm 為 +3 nm。擬合 Δx=t+s x，得到平移 t=2 nm、縮放 s=1 nm/mm=1 ppm。若 x=0 的保留點實測為 +4 nm，模型預測只有 +2 nm，殘差 +2 nm 提醒你兩個校準點不足以證明完整形變模型。
steps.instructionEn:

Use explicitly hypothetical data for one calculation or classification; retain units, denominators and intermediate results. Finally check your inference against this principle: Magnification error is not constant translation.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): In a one-dimensional example, overlay displacement is +1 nm at x=-1 mm and +3 nm at x=+1 mm. Fitting Δx=t+s x gives translation t=2 nm and scale s=1 nm/mm=1 ppm. If a held-out point at x=0 measures +4 nm, the model predicts only +2 nm and residual is +2 nm. Two calibration points do not establish a complete distortion model.

courses.summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究焦點劑量定義、窗口量測、感測與補償、變異與接受；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: focus and dose, window measurement, sensing and correction, variation and acceptance. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：假設線條 A 的合格焦距範圍為 [-40,40] nm、正規化劑量 [0.90,1.10]；接觸孔 B 為 [-20,30] nm、劑量 [0.95,1.05]，並先忽略交互作用。共同窗口為 [-20,30]×[0.95,1.05]，幾何中心是焦距 +5 nm、劑量 1.00。點 (+35 nm,1.00) 對 A 合格卻對共同窗口不合格。

Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Build a cause–measurement table separating direct observations, model inferences and conclusions needing more evidence. Finally check your inference against this principle: The common window can be narrower than an individual one.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Assume line A passes at focus [-40,40] nm and normalized dose [0.90,1.10]; contact B passes at [-20,30] nm and [0.95,1.05], initially ignoring interactions. Their common window is [-20,30]×[0.95,1.05], with geometric center (+5 nm,1.00). The point (+35 nm,1.00) passes A but fails the common window.

courses.title: 微影隨機缺陷分析
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究事件與機率、取樣與量測、來源分離、設計與接受；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: events and probability, sampling and metrology, source separation, design and acceptance. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
courses.scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

steps.instruction:

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：假設 N=100000 個獨立、同分布機會皆無缺陷。精確單側 95% 二項上限為 p=1-0.05^(1/N)=2.9957×10⁻⁵，近似 3/N=3.0×10⁻⁵。若報告 p=0，便超出資料支持範圍。另說明漏檢與空間相關會破壞此計算的假設；此範例沒有實際晶圓良率數據。

steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：只抽中心會漏掉空間非均勻。

steps.instructionEn: Sample across different wafer regions. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Use explicitly hypothetical data for one calculation or classification; retain units, denominators and intermediate results. Finally check your inference against this principle: Center-only sampling misses spatial nonuniformity.
steps.observation: 只抽中心會漏掉空間非均勻。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
steps.observationEn: Center-only sampling misses spatial nonuniformity. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

quiz.question: 完成「比較光阻、底層與蝕刻三個因素」後，哪項判讀可靠？
quiz.questionEn: After "Compare resist, underlayer and etch factors", which interpretation is defensible?

steps.title: 檢查缺陷是否以光罩位置重複
steps.titleEn: Check whether defects repeat at mask coordinates
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：重複缺陷可能屬於系統來源。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Repeating defects can indicate systematic origins.
steps.instruction: 檢查缺陷是否以光罩位置重複。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。建立因果與量測對照表，區分直接觀測、模型推論與尚需額外證據的結論。最後以「重複缺陷可能屬於系統來源。」檢查推論是否超出證據。
steps.instructionEn: Check whether defects repeat at mask coordinates. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Build a cause–measurement table separating direct observations, model inferences and conclusions needing more evidence. Finally check your inference against this principle: Repeating defects can indicate systematic origins.
steps.observation: 重複缺陷可能屬於系統來源。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
steps.observationEn: Repeating defects can indicate systematic origins. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
steps.failure: 若報告假設「所有缺陷都只由光子數決定。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
steps.failureEn: If the report assumes "Photon count alone determines every defect.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
steps.check: 交付「檢查缺陷是否以光罩位置重複」的圖表或計算、採用來源、假設與單位；說明本步結論「重複缺陷可能屬於系統來源。」可由哪些證據支持，並保留一項限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the diagram, table or calculation for "Check whether defects repeat at mask coordinates", with sources, assumptions and units. Identify evidence supporting "Repeating defects can indicate systematic origins." and retain one limitation.

courses.title: 反應式離子蝕刻
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究電漿與表面、輪廓與選擇性、端點與均勻性、損傷與轉移；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: plasma and surface, profile and selectivity, endpoint and uniformity, damage and transfer. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
courses.scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

steps.instruction:
以兩材料速率計算選擇比。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。建立兩種條件的對照表，分別寫出固定量、改變量與可量測的輸出。最後以「選擇比依材料對與條件定義。」檢查推論是否超出證據。

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：假設 20 s 內目標膜減少 100 nm、掩膜減少 10 nm。速率分別為 5.0 與 0.50 nm/s，選擇比為 10。若保持同速率再延長 4 s，目標膜多移除 20 nm、掩膜多損失 2 nm。說明此線性外推只適用於本假想穩態區間，不能忽略停止層與負載改變。
steps.instructionEn:
Calculate selectivity from two material rates. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Build a two-condition comparison table listing fixed quantities, changed quantities and measurable outputs. Finally check your inference against this principle: Selectivity is defined for a material pair and conditions.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Assume target loss of 100 nm and mask loss of 10 nm in 20 s. Rates are 5.0 and 0.50 nm/s, giving selectivity 10. Four extra seconds at the same rates remove 20 nm more target and 2 nm more mask. This linear extrapolation applies only to the hypothetical steady interval and cannot ignore stop layers or loading changes.

Report 5.0, 0.50, 10, 20 nm and 2 nm, distinguishing rates from selectivity.

steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：RIE 合格判準必須是多維度。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: RIE acceptance criteria must be multidimensional.
steps.instruction: 交付速率、輪廓、選擇性與損傷報告。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。完成一頁審查紀錄，列出接受條件、證據缺口與不應外推的範圍。最後以「RIE 合格判準必須是多維度。」檢查推論是否超出證據。
steps.instructionEn: Report rate, profile, selectivity and damage. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Complete a one-page review listing acceptance criteria, evidence gaps and limits on extrapolation. Finally check your inference against this principle: RIE acceptance criteria must be multidimensional.
steps.observation: RIE 合格判準必須是多維度。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
steps.observationEn: RIE acceptance criteria must be multidimensional. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
steps.failure: 若報告假設「側壁筆直就可排除電性損傷。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
steps.failureEn: If the report assumes "Straight sidewalls rule out electrical damage.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
steps.check: 交付「交付速率、輪廓、選擇性與損傷報告」的圖表或計算、採用來源、假設與單位；說明本步結論「RIE 合格判準必須是多維度。」可由哪些證據支持，並保留一項限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the diagram, table or calculation for "Report rate, profile, selectivity and damage", with sources, assumptions and units. Identify evidence supporting "RIE acceptance criteria must be multidimensional." and retain one limitation.

knowledge.text: RIE 合格判準必須是多維度。
knowledge.textEn: RIE acceptance criteria must be multidimensional.

knowledge.title: 損傷與轉移的原理與限制
knowledge.titleEn: Damage and transfer: principle and limits
knowledge.text: 完成圖案仍需檢查表面、電性與污染。

quiz.question: 完成「交付速率、輪廓、選擇性與損傷報告」後，哪項判讀可靠？
quiz.questionEn: After "Report rate, profile, selectivity and damage", which interpretation is defensible?
options: 側壁筆直就可排除電性損傷。
RIE 完全只有物理撞擊。
RIE 合格判準必須是多維度。
optionsEn: Straight sidewalls rule out electrical damage.
RIE is purely physical bombardment.
RIE acceptance criteria must be multidimensional.

quiz.explanationEn: RIE acceptance criteria must be multidimensional. Completed patterns still need surface, electrical and contamination checks.

courses.title: 原子層蝕刻
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究自限制反應、循環與視窗、三維與選擇性、電性與效率；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: self-limiting reactions, cycles and windows, 3d and selectivity, electrical quality and efficiency. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
courses.scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

stages.title: 自限制反應
stages.description: ALE 必須以飽和與對照證據確認自限制性，不能只因製程循環就稱為原子層蝕刻。
stages.descriptionEn: ALE requires saturation and control evidence of self-limitation; cycling alone is insufficient.

steps.title: 畫出表面改質與移除兩個半循環
steps.titleEn: Draw surface-modification and removal half-cycles
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：反應分離是循環控制的核心。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Separated reactions enable cycle control.
steps.instruction: 畫出表面改質與移除兩個半循環。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。附上帶材料、方向與尺度標記的示意圖，圈出一處不能由圖單獨推論的量。最後以「反應分離是循環控制的核心。」檢查推論是否超出證據。
steps.instructionEn: Draw surface-modification and removal half-cycles. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Attach a diagram labeled with materials, directions and scales; circle one quantity not inferable from the drawing alone. Finally check your inference against this principle: Separated reactions enable cycle control.
steps.observation: 反應分離是循環控制的核心。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
steps.observationEn: Separated reactions enable cycle control. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

quiz.question: 完成「畫出表面改質與移除兩個半循環」後，哪項判讀可靠？
quiz.questionEn: After "Draw surface-modification and removal half-cycles", which interpretation is defensible?

Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Build a cause–measurement table separating direct observations, model inferences and conclusions needing more evidence. Finally check your inference against this principle: Removal of unmodified surfaces affects synergy.

steps.title: 計算完整循環與對照的協同程度
steps.titleEn: Compare full-cycle removal with controls
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：完整循環需優於獨立步驟的非選擇性效果。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Full cycles must be distinguished from independent nonspecific removal.
steps.instruction:
計算完整循環與對照的協同程度。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。列出一個可能混淆原因，提出能區分兩個解釋的對照或額外量測。最後以「完整循環需優於獨立步驟的非選擇性效果。」檢查推論是否超出證據。

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：設完整循環移除量 0.20 nm；僅改質對照 0.02 nm；僅移除對照 0.03 nm。本例定義協同分率 S=[E_full-(E_mod+E_remove)]/E_full，得到 S=0.75。即使 S 高，仍必須另畫暴露時間飽和曲線，因為協同性不單獨證明自限制；0.20 nm 也不代表恰好一個晶格層。
steps.instructionEn:
Compare full-cycle removal with controls. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. List one plausible confounder and propose a control or measurement distinguishing two explanations. Finally check your inference against this principle: Full cycles must be distinguished from independent nonspecific removal.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Let full-cycle removal be 0.20 nm, modification-only removal 0.02 nm and removal-only control 0.03 nm. Define synergy S=[E_full-(E_mod+E_remove)]/E_full; S=0.75. High synergy still requires exposure-time saturation curves because synergy alone does not establish self-limitation. Nor does 0.20 nm necessarily equal one lattice plane.
steps.observation:
完整循環需優於獨立步驟的非選擇性效果。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
以明示定義得到 75%，並保留飽和性尚需驗證的結論。
steps.observationEn:
Full cycles must be distinguished from independent nonspecific removal. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Obtain 75% using the stated definition and retain the need for saturation verification.
steps.failure: 若報告假設「任何分段電漿都可直接稱為 ALE。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
steps.failureEn: If the report assumes "Any segmented plasma process is automatically ALE.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.

本例驗收：以明示定義得到 75%，並保留飽和性尚需驗證的結論。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the diagram, table or calculation for "Compare full-cycle removal with controls", with sources, assumptions and units. Identify evidence supporting "Full cycles must be distinguished from independent nonspecific removal." and retain one limitation.
Example acceptance: Obtain 75% using the stated definition and retain the need for saturation verification.

knowledge.title: 具體案例、推導與適用限制
knowledge.text: 設完整循環移除量 0.20 nm；僅改質對照 0.02 nm；僅移除對照 0.03 nm。本例定義協同分率 S=[E_full-(E_mod+E_remove)]/E_full，得到 S=0.75。即使 S 高，仍必須另畫暴露時間飽和曲線，因為協同性不單獨證明自限制；0.20 nm 也不代表恰好一個晶格層。
knowledge.textEn: Let full-cycle removal be 0.20 nm, modification-only removal 0.02 nm and removal-only control 0.03 nm. Define synergy S=[E_full-(E_mod+E_remove)]/E_full; S=0.75. High synergy still requires exposure-time saturation curves because synergy alone does not establish self-limitation. Nor does 0.20 nm necessarily equal one lattice plane.

knowledge.text: 每循環移除量與循環數的關係可能有成核或暫態階段。
knowledge.textEn: Removal per cycle can include nucleation or transient behavior.

quiz.question: 完成「以厚度對循環數求每循環移除量」後，哪項判讀可靠？
quiz.questionEn: After "Fit removal per cycle from thickness versus cycles", which interpretation is defensible?
options: 每個循環必定精確移除一個完整晶格層。
線性區間應明確標示。
自限制就表示所有材料完全不受影響。
optionsEn: Each cycle necessarily removes exactly one complete lattice plane.
The fitted linear range must be stated.
Self-limitation means all other materials are completely unaffected.

courses.summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究深矽幾何、循環與低溫、深度與輪廓、整合與可靠度；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: deep-silicon geometry, cycling and cryogenics, depth and profile, integration and reliability. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
courses.scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

stages.title: 深矽幾何
stages.description: DRIE 的深度與方向性須同時考慮掩膜、反應物運輸及側壁保護。
stages.descriptionEn: DRIE depth and directionality depend on mask, transport and sidewall protection together.

steps.title: 用孔深除以孔寬定義深寬比
steps.titleEn: Define aspect ratio from depth and width
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：深寬比需註明採用的橫向尺度。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Aspect ratio needs a stated lateral dimension.
steps.instruction: 用孔深除以孔寬定義深寬比。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。附上帶材料、方向與尺度標記的示意圖，圈出一處不能由圖單獨推論的量。最後以「深寬比需註明採用的橫向尺度。」檢查推論是否超出證據。
steps.instructionEn: Define aspect ratio from depth and width. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Attach a diagram labeled with materials, directions and scales; circle one quantity not inferable from the drawing alone. Finally check your inference against this principle: Aspect ratio needs a stated lateral dimension.
steps.observation: 深寬比需註明採用的橫向尺度。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
steps.observationEn: Aspect ratio needs a stated lateral dimension. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
steps.failure: 若報告假設「只延長時間就能維持相同輪廓無限加深。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
steps.failureEn: If the report assumes "Longer time preserves the same profile at unlimited depth.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
steps.check: 交付「用孔深除以孔寬定義深寬比」的圖表或計算、採用來源、假設與單位；說明本步結論「深寬比需註明採用的橫向尺度。」可由哪些證據支持，並保留一項限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the diagram, table or calculation for "Define aspect ratio from depth and width", with sources, assumptions and units. Identify evidence supporting "Aspect ratio needs a stated lateral dimension." and retain one limitation.

knowledge.title: 本步技術判讀
knowledge.text: 深寬比需註明採用的橫向尺度。
knowledge.textEn: Aspect ratio needs a stated lateral dimension.

knowledge.title: 深矽幾何的原理與限制
knowledge.text: DRIE 的深度與方向性須同時考慮掩膜、反應物運輸及側壁保護。
knowledge.textEn: DRIE depth and directionality depend on mask, transport and sidewall protection together.

quiz.question: 完成「用孔深除以孔寬定義深寬比」後，哪項判讀可靠？
quiz.questionEn: After "Define aspect ratio from depth and width", which interpretation is defensible?
options: 深寬比需註明採用的橫向尺度。
只延長時間就能維持相同輪廓無限加深。
Bosch 與低溫蝕刻的鈍化完全相同。
optionsEn: Aspect ratio needs a stated lateral dimension.
Longer time preserves the same profile at unlimited depth.
Bosch and cryogenic passivation are identical.
quiz.explanation: 深寬比需註明採用的橫向尺度。 DRIE 的深度與方向性須同時考慮掩膜、反應物運輸及側壁保護。
quiz.explanationEn: Aspect ratio needs a stated lateral dimension. DRIE depth and directionality depend on mask, transport and sidewall protection together.

steps.title: 估算硬罩消耗所允許的深度
steps.titleEn: Estimate mask-limited achievable depth
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：高選擇比仍需保留厚度裕量。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: High selectivity still needs thickness margin.
steps.instruction:
估算硬罩消耗所允許的深度。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。用自訂並標明的假設資料做一個計算或分類例，保留單位、分母與中間結果。最後以「高選擇比仍需保留厚度裕量。」檢查推論是否超出證據。

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：假設溝槽目標深度 100 μm、孔寬 5 μm，深寬比為 20。若矽對硬罩選擇比為 50，理想硬罩消耗為 2 μm；初始 2.5 μm 僅剩 0.5 μm。若另需 20% 等效過蝕刻，硬罩總消耗為 2.4 μm，只剩 0.1 μm。數值是假想預算，未包含均勻性與側向侵蝕。
steps.instructionEn:
Estimate mask-limited achievable depth. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Use explicitly hypothetical data for one calculation or classification; retain units, denominators and intermediate results. Finally check your inference against this principle: High selectivity still needs thickness margin.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Assume a 100 μm target depth and 5 μm width: aspect ratio is 20. At silicon-to-mask selectivity 50, ideal mask loss is 2 μm, leaving 0.5 μm from an initial 2.5 μm. Adding 20% equivalent overetch raises loss to 2.4 μm and leaves only 0.1 μm. These are hypothetical budgets excluding nonuniformity and lateral erosion.
steps.observation:
高選擇比仍需保留厚度裕量。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
須報告 AR=20、剩餘 0.5/0.1 μm，並指出小裕量風險。
steps.observationEn:
High selectivity still needs thickness margin. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Report AR=20 and 0.5/0.1 μm remainder, identifying the small-margin risk.
steps.failure: 若報告假設「只延長時間就能維持相同輪廓無限加深。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
steps.failureEn: If the report assumes "Longer time preserves the same profile at unlimited depth.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
steps.check:
交付「估算硬罩消耗所允許的深度」的圖表或計算、採用來源、假設與單位；說明本步結論「高選擇比仍需保留厚度裕量。」可由哪些證據支持，並保留一項限制。
本例驗收：須報告 AR=20、剩餘 0.5/0.1 μm，並指出小裕量風險。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the diagram, table or calculation for "Estimate mask-limited achievable depth", with sources, assumptions and units. Identify evidence supporting "High selectivity still needs thickness margin." and retain one limitation.
Example acceptance: Report AR=20 and 0.5/0.1 μm remainder, identifying the small-margin risk.

courses.title: 高深寬比介電層蝕刻
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究介電堆疊、輸運與充電、輪廓控制、端點與功能；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: dielectric stacks, transport and charging, profile control, endpoint and function. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
courses.scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

courses.title: 選擇性矽鍺蝕刻
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究材料與選擇性、反應與幾何、釋放與表面、元件整合；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: materials and selectivity, reaction and geometry, release and surfaces, device integration. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
courses.scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

courses.title: 電漿端點偵測
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究訊號來源、訊號處理、停止邏輯、驗證與漂移；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: signal origins, signal processing, stop logic, validation and drift. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
courses.scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

steps.instruction:

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：假設穩態速率 2.0 nm/s，感測延遲 0.20 s、濾波判讀 0.50 s、停止反應延遲 0.30 s。總延遲 1.00 s，額外移除量約 2.0 nm。若實際速率介於 1.8–2.2 nm/s，延遲所致移除量也介於 1.8–2.2 nm。忽略化學反應停止後的殘餘效應，並把此限制寫入報告。
steps.instructionEn:

Use explicitly hypothetical data for one calculation or classification; retain units, denominators and intermediate results. Finally check your inference against this principle: Rate uncertainty propagates into depth error.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Assume steady removal 2.0 nm/s, sensing delay 0.20 s, filtering/decision delay 0.50 s and process-stop delay 0.30 s. Total latency is 1.00 s, causing about 2.0 nm extra removal. A rate range of 1.8–2.2 nm/s gives 1.8–2.2 nm extra removal. State that residual post-stop chemistry is excluded.

Rate uncertainty propagates into depth error. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

knowledge.text: 端點模型需要以實際剩餘膜厚與腔體歷程持續驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Endpoint models need validation against remaining thickness and chamber history.

quiz.question: 完成「建立誤停與漏停的成本矩陣」後，哪項判讀可靠？
quiz.questionEn: After "Build a cost matrix for early and missed stops", which interpretation is defensible?
options: 一次校準後不需要再量膜厚。
兩種失敗的後果可能不對稱。
所有亮度變化都等於材料已蝕刻完。
optionsEn: One calibration removes the need for further thickness measurement.
The consequences of the two failures can be asymmetric.
Every brightness change means etching is complete.
quiz.explanation: 兩種失敗的後果可能不對稱。 端點模型需要以實際剩餘膜厚與腔體歷程持續驗證。
quiz.explanationEn: The consequences of the two failures can be asymmetric. Endpoint models need validation against remaining thickness and chamber history.

steps.title: 交付具回溯資料的端點控制計畫
steps.titleEn: Deliver an endpoint plan with traceable data
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：每次停止應能對應訊號與膜厚證據。

steps.instructionEn: Deliver an endpoint plan with traceable data. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Complete a one-page review listing acceptance criteria, evidence gaps and limits on extrapolation. Finally check your inference against this principle: Each stop should link to signal and thickness evidence.

courses.title: 電漿增強化學氣相沉積
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究電漿與成膜、膜性與應力、三維覆蓋、整合與可靠度；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: plasma and growth, film properties and stress, 3d coverage, integration and reliability. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
courses.scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

stages.title: 電漿與成膜
stages.description: PECVD 利用電漿活化反應，較低基板溫度不代表所有損傷都較低。
stages.descriptionEn: PECVD activates reactions with plasma; lower substrate temperature does not guarantee lower total damage.

steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Gas-phase and surface reactions both contribute to deposition.
steps.instruction: 畫出電漿活化到表面反應路徑。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。附上帶材料、方向與尺度標記的示意圖，圈出一處不能由圖單獨推論的量。最後以「氣相與表面反應共同參與沉積。」檢查推論是否超出證據。
steps.instructionEn: Trace plasma activation into surface growth. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Attach a diagram labeled with materials, directions and scales; circle one quantity not inferable from the drawing alone. Finally check your inference against this principle: Gas-phase and surface reactions both contribute to deposition.

steps.observationEn: Gas-phase and surface reactions both contribute to deposition. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

steps.failureEn: If the report assumes "Lower temperature guarantees no plasma damage.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
steps.check: 交付「畫出電漿活化到表面反應路徑」的圖表或計算、採用來源、假設與單位；說明本步結論「氣相與表面反應共同參與沉積。」可由哪些證據支持，並保留一項限制。

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：假設三個爐管位置的見證片膜厚為 50、55、60 nm。平均值為 55 nm；本例定義半範圍不均勻度 U=(max-min)/(2mean)=9.09%。若另一批三片皆 55 nm，平均仍相同但 U=0。只用批次平均無法判斷軸向均勻性；三片也不足以證明所有晶圓位置。
steps.instructionEn:
Plan witness wafers along the furnace. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Attach a diagram labeled with materials, directions and scales; circle one quantity not inferable from the drawing alone. Finally check your inference against this principle: Axial sampling reveals reactant and temperature gradients.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Three hypothetical furnace witness wafers measure 50, 55 and 60 nm. Mean is 55 nm; define half-range nonuniformity U=(max-min)/(2mean)=9.09%. Another batch with three 55 nm values has the same mean but U=0. Batch means cannot establish axial uniformity, and three wafers cannot establish every position.

courses.summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究前驅物與磊晶、反應器與均勻性、結構與光電性、界面與整合；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: precursors and epitaxy, reactor and uniformity, structure and optoelectronics, interfaces and integration. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
courses.scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

steps.instruction:
比較光激發光峰位與線寬。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。建立兩種條件的對照表，分別寫出固定量、改變量與可量測的輸出。最後以「光譜需要結合厚度、成分與缺陷解釋。」檢查推論是否超出證據。

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：假設兩片磊晶樣品的 PL 峰位為 450 與 460 nm，以 E≈1240/λ(nm) eV 換算為 2.756 與 2.696 eV，能量下降約 0.060 eV。這個紅移可能牽涉組成、應變、溫度或量子井厚度，不能只由峰位反推唯一材料組成；提出 XRD 或厚度對照以區分。
steps.instructionEn:
Compare photoluminescence peak position and width. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Build a two-condition comparison table listing fixed quantities, changed quantities and measurable outputs. Finally check your inference against this principle: Spectra need interpretation with thickness, composition and defects.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Hypothetical epitaxial samples have PL peaks at 450 and 460 nm. E≈1240/λ(nm) eV gives 2.756 and 2.696 eV, a decrease of about 0.060 eV. Composition, strain, temperature or well thickness can cause such a redshift; peak position alone cannot uniquely determine composition. Propose XRD or thickness controls to distinguish causes.
steps.observation:
光譜需要結合厚度、成分與缺陷解釋。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
算出約 60 meV 紅移，並保留至少兩種可能原因。
steps.observationEn:
Spectra need interpretation with thickness, composition and defects. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Calculate an approximately 60 meV redshift and retain at least two possible causes.

steps.failureEn: If the report assumes "Equal emission intensity proves identical crystal quality.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.

steps.title: 比較 AFM 粗糙度與密度指標
steps.titleEn: Compare AFM roughness with density measures

steps.instructionEn: Compare AFM roughness with density measures. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Build a cause–measurement table separating direct observations, model inferences and conclusions needing more evidence. Finally check your inference against this principle: Smoothness alone does not prove high density.
steps.observation: 表面平滑不能單獨證明高密度。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
steps.observationEn: Smoothness alone does not prove high density. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
steps.failure: 若報告假設「較厚薄膜一定較低應力。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
steps.failureEn: If the report assumes "Thicker films necessarily have lower stress.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.

steps.title: 量測薄膜片電阻與連續性
steps.titleEn: Measure sheet resistance and continuity
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：超薄膜可能未形成連續導電路徑。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Ultrathin films may lack continuous conducting paths.
steps.instruction:
量測薄膜片電阻與連續性。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。完成一頁審查紀錄，列出接受條件、證據缺口與不應外推的範圍。最後以「超薄膜可能未形成連續導電路徑。」檢查推論是否超出證據。

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：假設均勻且連續的濺鍍膜厚 50 nm，片電阻 20 Ω/□。由 ρ=Rs t 得 ρ=1.0×10⁻⁶ Ω·m=100 μΩ·cm。若厚度估計偏高 10%，推算電阻率也偏高 10%。此關係假設連續膜與適當幾何修正；不連續島狀膜不能直接用同一塊材模型解釋。
steps.instructionEn:
Measure sheet resistance and continuity. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Complete a one-page review listing acceptance criteria, evidence gaps and limits on extrapolation. Finally check your inference against this principle: Ultrathin films may lack continuous conducting paths.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Assume a uniform continuous sputtered film 50 nm thick with sheet resistance 20 Ω/□. ρ=Rs t gives 1.0×10⁻⁶ Ω·m=100 μΩ·cm. A 10% high thickness estimate makes inferred resistivity 10% high. The relation assumes a continuous film and proper geometry correction; disconnected islands cannot be interpreted with the same bulk-film model.
steps.observation:
超薄膜可能未形成連續導電路徑。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
交付 100 μΩ·cm、誤差傳遞與連續膜假設。
steps.observationEn:
Ultrathin films may lack continuous conducting paths. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Report 100 μΩ·cm, error propagation and the continuous-film assumption.
steps.failure: 若報告假設「較厚薄膜一定較低應力。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
steps.failureEn: If the report assumes "Thicker films necessarily have lower stress.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
steps.check:
交付「量測薄膜片電阻與連續性」的圖表或計算、採用來源、假設與單位；說明本步結論「超薄膜可能未形成連續導電路徑。」可由哪些證據支持，並保留一項限制。
本例驗收：交付 100 μΩ·cm、誤差傳遞與連續膜假設。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the diagram, table or calculation for "Measure sheet resistance and continuity", with sources, assumptions and units. Identify evidence supporting "Ultrathin films may lack continuous conducting paths." and retain one limitation.
Example acceptance: Report 100 μΩ·cm, error propagation and the continuous-film assumption.

courses.title: 鎢插塞製作
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究接點與材料、成核與填充、平坦化與介面、電性與可靠度；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: contacts and materials, nucleation and fill, planarization and interfaces, electrical quality and reliability. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
courses.scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

steps.title: 分開體電阻與接觸電阻
steps.titleEn: Separate bulk and interface resistance
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：介面可在小尺寸下占重要比例。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Interfaces can dominate at small dimensions.
steps.instruction:
分開體電阻與接觸電阻。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。建立因果與量測對照表，區分直接觀測、模型推論與尚需額外證據的結論。最後以「介面可在小尺寸下占重要比例。」檢查推論是否超出證據。

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：假設圓柱插塞長 100 nm、直徑 20 nm、有效電阻率 2.0×10⁻⁷ Ω·m。R=ρL/[π(d/2)²]≈63.7 Ω；上下介面各 10 Ω 時總計約 83.7 Ω。直徑減半時主體電阻變為約 254.6 Ω，總計 274.6 Ω，而不是 83.7 的四倍；介面在此簡化例中假設固定。
steps.instructionEn:
Separate bulk and interface resistance. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Build a cause–measurement table separating direct observations, model inferences and conclusions needing more evidence. Finally check your inference against this principle: Interfaces can dominate at small dimensions.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Assume a cylindrical plug with length 100 nm, diameter 20 nm and effective resistivity 2.0×10⁻⁷ Ω·m. R=ρL/[π(d/2)²]≈63.7 Ω. With 10 Ω at each interface, total is about 83.7 Ω. Halving diameter raises bulk resistance to about 254.6 Ω and total to 274.6 Ω, not four times 83.7; interfaces are held constant in this simplified model.

knowledge.text: 總電阻包含體材料、幾何與上下介面。
knowledge.textEn: Total resistance includes bulk material, geometry and both interfaces.

quiz.question: 完成「將空洞位置與電阻異常對應」後，哪項判讀可靠？
quiz.questionEn: After "Relate void locations to resistance anomalies", which interpretation is defensible?
options: 形貌因果需用同位置證據。
單一接點導通即可證明整批可靠。
鎢體電阻率即可決定所有接點電阻。
optionsEn: Morphological causality needs co-located evidence.
One conducting contact proves whole-lot reliability.
Bulk tungsten resistivity determines every contact resistance.
quiz.explanation: 形貌因果需用同位置證據。 總電阻包含體材料、幾何與上下介面。
quiz.explanationEn: Morphological causality needs co-located evidence. Total resistance includes bulk material, geometry and both interfaces.

steps.title: 檢查熱循環後的接點穩定度
steps.titleEn: Assess contact stability after thermal cycling
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：初始導通不等於長期穩定。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Initial continuity is not long-term stability.
steps.instruction: 檢查熱循環後的接點穩定度。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。列出一個可能混淆原因，提出能區分兩個解釋的對照或額外量測。最後以「初始導通不等於長期穩定。」檢查推論是否超出證據。
steps.instructionEn: Assess contact stability after thermal cycling. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. List one plausible confounder and propose a control or measurement distinguishing two explanations. Finally check your inference against this principle: Initial continuity is not long-term stability.
steps.observation: 初始導通不等於長期穩定。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
steps.observationEn: Initial continuity is not long-term stability. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
steps.failure: 若報告假設「單一接點導通即可證明整批可靠。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
steps.failureEn: If the report assumes "One conducting contact proves whole-lot reliability.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
steps.check: 交付「檢查熱循環後的接點穩定度」的圖表或計算、採用來源、假設與單位；說明本步結論「初始導通不等於長期穩定。」可由哪些證據支持，並保留一項限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the diagram, table or calculation for "Assess contact stability after thermal cycling", with sources, assumptions and units. Identify evidence supporting "Initial continuity is not long-term stability." and retain one limitation.

courses.title: 銅雙鑲嵌互連
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究線孔整合、蝕刻與襯層、填銅與平坦化、RC 與可靠度；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: line–via integration, etch and liners, copper fill and planarization, rc and reliability. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
courses.scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

stages.title: 線孔整合
stages.description: 雙鑲嵌先在介電層形成線槽與通孔，再以金屬填入。
stages.descriptionEn: Dual damascene forms trenches and vias in dielectric before metal filling.

steps.title: 畫出兩金屬層之間的通孔與線槽
steps.titleEn: Draw a via and trench between metal levels
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：垂直與水平連接具有不同幾何。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Vertical and horizontal connections have different geometry.
steps.instruction: 畫出兩金屬層之間的通孔與線槽。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。附上帶材料、方向與尺度標記的示意圖，圈出一處不能由圖單獨推論的量。最後以「垂直與水平連接具有不同幾何。」檢查推論是否超出證據。
steps.instructionEn: Draw a via and trench between metal levels. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Attach a diagram labeled with materials, directions and scales; circle one quantity not inferable from the drawing alone. Finally check your inference against this principle: Vertical and horizontal connections have different geometry.
steps.observation: 垂直與水平連接具有不同幾何。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
steps.observationEn: Vertical and horizontal connections have different geometry. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
steps.failure: 若報告假設「雙鑲嵌就是直接蝕刻厚銅形成所有線孔。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
steps.failureEn: If the report assumes "Dual damascene directly etches thick copper into all lines and vias.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
steps.check: 交付「畫出兩金屬層之間的通孔與線槽」的圖表或計算、採用來源、假設與單位；說明本步結論「垂直與水平連接具有不同幾何。」可由哪些證據支持，並保留一項限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the diagram, table or calculation for "Draw a via and trench between metal levels", with sources, assumptions and units. Identify evidence supporting "Vertical and horizontal connections have different geometry." and retain one limitation.

knowledge.text: 垂直與水平連接具有不同幾何。
knowledge.textEn: Vertical and horizontal connections have different geometry.

knowledge.title: 線孔整合的原理與限制
knowledge.text: 雙鑲嵌先在介電層形成線槽與通孔，再以金屬填入。
knowledge.textEn: Dual damascene forms trenches and vias in dielectric before metal filling.

quiz.question: 完成「畫出兩金屬層之間的通孔與線槽」後，哪項判讀可靠？
quiz.questionEn: After "Draw a via and trench between metal levels", which interpretation is defensible?
options: 垂直與水平連接具有不同幾何。
雙鑲嵌就是直接蝕刻厚銅形成所有線孔。
阻障層越厚越不需要考慮電阻。
optionsEn: Vertical and horizontal connections have different geometry.
Dual damascene directly etches thick copper into all lines and vias.
Thicker barriers remove resistance concerns.
quiz.explanation: 垂直與水平連接具有不同幾何。 雙鑲嵌先在介電層形成線槽與通孔，再以金屬填入。

steps.title: 以線電阻分離幾何與材料貢獻

steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：有效截面包括襯層占用。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Effective cross section accounts for liner occupancy.
steps.instruction:
以線電阻分離幾何與材料貢獻。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。附上帶材料、方向與尺度標記的示意圖，圈出一處不能由圖單獨推論的量。最後以「有效截面包括襯層占用。」檢查推論是否超出證據。

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：假設線槽寬 40 nm、高 60 nm，兩側與底部各由 3 nm 非銅襯層占用，不計頂部帽層。銅截面為 (40-6)(60-3)=1938 nm²，而外部截面為 2400 nm²。若銅電阻率與長度固定，襯層占用使電阻相對理想全銅增加 2400/1938-1≈23.8%。這尚未計入尺寸散射與接觸電阻。
steps.instructionEn:
Separate geometric and material contributions to line resistance. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Attach a diagram labeled with materials, directions and scales; circle one quantity not inferable from the drawing alone. Finally check your inference against this principle: Effective cross section accounts for liner occupancy.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Assume a 40 nm wide, 60 nm tall trench with 3 nm non-copper liners on both sides and bottom, excluding a top cap. Copper area is (40-6)(60-3)=1938 nm² versus 2400 nm² external area. With fixed copper resistivity and length, liner occupancy raises resistance by 2400/1938-1≈23.8% over ideal all-copper. Size scattering and contact resistance are excluded.
steps.observation:
有效截面包括襯層占用。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
交付 1938 nm² 與 23.8%，標出襯層位於兩側和底部。
steps.observationEn:
Effective cross section accounts for liner occupancy. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Report 1938 nm² and 23.8%, marking liners on both sides and bottom.

steps.title: 建立相同有效截面的公平基準
steps.titleEn: Build a fair benchmark at matched conducting area
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：名目線寬相同未必導電面積相同。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Equal nominal width need not mean equal conducting area.
steps.instruction:
建立相同有效截面的公平基準。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。完成一頁審查紀錄，列出接受條件、證據缺口與不應外推的範圍。最後以「名目線寬相同未必導電面積相同。」檢查推論是否超出證據。

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：以同一外框 20×30 nm² 比較假想材料。Cu 有兩側與底部 3 nm 襯層，導電面積 14×27=378 nm²，有效ρ=4 μΩ·cm；無襯層候選金屬面積600 nm²、有效ρ=6 μΩ·cm。相同線長下比較 ρ/A，比例為 (6/600)/(4/378)=0.945；較高ρ的候選反而低阻約5.5%。這不證明無襯層可靠，須另驗證擴散與附著。
steps.instructionEn:
Build a fair benchmark at matched conducting area. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Complete a one-page review listing acceptance criteria, evidence gaps and limits on extrapolation. Finally check your inference against this principle: Equal nominal width need not mean equal conducting area.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Compare hypothetical materials in the same 20×30 nm² footprint. Cu has 3 nm side/bottom liners, conducting area 14×27=378 nm² and effective ρ=4 μΩ·cm. A linerless candidate has area 600 nm² and effective ρ=6 μΩ·cm. At equal length, resistance ratio is (6/600)/(4/378)=0.945: the higher-ρ candidate is about 5.5% lower in resistance. This does not prove linerless reliability; diffusion and adhesion need separate tests.

Equal nominal width need not mean equal conducting area. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

courses.title: 低介電常數互連介電層
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究電容與孔隙、成膜與固化、圖案化損傷、機械與可靠度；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: capacitance and porosity, growth and curing, patterning damage, mechanics and reliability. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
