steps.title: 建立 RC 延遲的簡化比較
steps.titleEn: Build a simplified RC-delay comparison
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：低 k 的收益需與導線電阻共同評估。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Low-k benefits need evaluation with line resistance.
steps.instruction:
建立 RC 延遲的簡化比較。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。建立因果與量測對照表，區分直接觀測、模型推論與尚需額外證據的結論。最後以「低 k 的收益需與導線電阻共同評估。」檢查推論是否超出證據。

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：假設幾何不變，介電常數從 4.0 降為 2.8，電容比 C₂/C₁=0.70。若電阻保持不變，RC 降低30%；但若新整合使電阻增加50%，RC 比值變為 1.5×0.70=1.05，反而增加5%。本例以集中參數 RC 說明取捨，不等於完整訊號時序模擬。
steps.instructionEn:
Build a simplified RC-delay comparison. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Build a cause–measurement table separating direct observations, model inferences and conclusions needing more evidence. Finally check your inference against this principle: Low-k benefits need evaluation with line resistance.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): At fixed geometry, lowering permittivity from 4.0 to 2.8 gives capacitance ratio 0.70. With unchanged resistance, RC falls 30%; if the new integration raises resistance by 50%, RC ratio becomes 1.5×0.70=1.05, a 5% increase. This lumped-RC example illustrates tradeoffs rather than full timing simulation.
steps.observation:
低 k 的收益需與導線電阻共同評估。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
須同時給出 0.70 與 1.05，避免把低 k 等同更低延遲。
steps.observationEn:
Low-k benefits need evaluation with line resistance. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Report both 0.70 and 1.05 rather than equating lower k with lower delay.
steps.failure: 若報告假設「只要孔隙越多就一定更適合整合。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。

steps.check:

本例驗收：須同時給出 0.70 與 1.05，避免把低 k 等同更低延遲。

courses.title: 阻障層與種子層沉積
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究功能與截面、沉積與連續性、介面與填充、擴散與可靠度；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: functions and sections, deposition and continuity, interfaces and filling, diffusion and reliability. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
courses.scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

stages.title: 功能與截面
stages.description: 阻障層阻擋擴散，種子層提供電鍍起始與導電路徑，功能不可混同。
stages.descriptionEn: Barriers block diffusion; seeds enable plating and electrical continuity; the roles differ.

steps.instruction:
估算襯層占用的導電截面。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。用自訂並標明的假設資料做一個計算或分類例，保留單位、分母與中間結果。最後以「尺度縮小時占比會提高。」檢查推論是否超出證據。

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：假設矩形溝槽外框 20×40 nm²，襯層只占兩側與底部。厚度 2 nm 時導電截面為 16×38=608 nm²；厚度 3 nm 時為14×37=518 nm²。固定ρ與長度後，電阻比為608/518≈1.174，增加17.4%。但較薄層若有針孔，不能只憑低電阻選用；補上擴散可靠度關卡。
steps.instructionEn:
Estimate conducting area consumed by liners. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Use explicitly hypothetical data for one calculation or classification; retain units, denominators and intermediate results. Finally check your inference against this principle: The fractional occupancy grows as dimensions shrink.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Assume a 20×40 nm² trench with liners on both sides and bottom. At 2 nm thickness, conducting area is 16×38=608 nm²; at 3 nm it is 14×37=518 nm². With fixed ρ and length, resistance ratio is 608/518≈1.174, a 17.4% increase. A thinner layer with pinholes cannot be selected on resistance alone; add diffusion-reliability gates.
steps.observation:

交付 608、518 nm²與17.4%，且不得省略阻障完整性。
steps.observationEn:
The fractional occupancy grows as dimensions shrink. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Report 608 and 518 nm² and 17.4%, retaining barrier-integrity requirements.

courses.summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究電化學與供電、傳質與添加劑、超共形填充、缺陷與後段；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: electrochemistry and current, transport and additives, superconformal filling, defects and downstream processing. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
courses.scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
courses.scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

steps.title: 用法拉第定律估算理想沉積質量
steps.titleEn: Estimate ideal deposited mass with Faraday's law
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：實際質量還依賴電流效率。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Actual mass also depends on current efficiency.
steps.instruction:
用法拉第定律估算理想沉積質量。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。建立兩種條件的對照表，分別寫出固定量、改變量與可量測的輸出。最後以「實際質量還依賴電流效率。」檢查推論是否超出證據。

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：用純粹教學電荷帳本：Cu²⁺還原為 Cu，假設 Q=0.10 C，M=63.546 g/mol，F=96485 C/mol，z=2。理想質量 m=MQ/(zF)=32.93 μg；若電流效率90%，則為29.64 μg。這不包含任何鍍液組成或操作條件；需再用截面體積與銅密度檢查電荷、體積及損失是否一致。
steps.instructionEn:
Estimate ideal deposited mass with Faraday's law. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Build a two-condition comparison table listing fixed quantities, changed quantities and measurable outputs. Finally check your inference against this principle: Actual mass also depends on current efficiency.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): For an educational charge ledger, reduce Cu²⁺ to Cu with Q=0.10 C, M=63.546 g/mol, F=96485 C/mol and z=2. Ideal mass m=MQ/(zF)=32.93 μg; at 90% current efficiency it is 29.64 μg. No bath composition or operating conditions are supplied. Check consistency against cross-sectional volume and copper density to account for charge, volume and losses.
